stem: Gametes produced by an organism contain a combination of genes from that organism. In every gamete, this combination is —

options.label: A
options.text: the same because it is created from the same DNA

options.label: B
options.text: the same because chromosomes are copied prior to meiosis

options.label: C
options.text: different due to DNA replication prior to mitosis

options.label: D
options.text: different due to independent assortment during meiosis
